# Chapter 2

Date: 2026-03-08

## Scenes

### 002.01 The Ledger

Sella Marr showed the party the Lantern Guild ledger, listing debts owed by Emberfall. Ruck Halloway read it twice and said nothing.

#### Sella Marr reveals the ledger.

- Sella Marr says the Guild would forgive the debts for a price, to be named later.

### 002.02 The Apprentice's Trail

Brannoc Ironvein pointed the party toward the north road, where his apprentice was last seen.

#### Brannoc points the way.

- Brannoc gives the party his apprentice's hammer as a token.

## Memorable Moments

> "The Guild always names its price last."
> — Sister Ines
